title: Daily Habits to Boost Immunity
content:
# 🛌 Lifestyle Guide for Boosting Immunity

## ![Immunity](immune.jpg)
1. Importance of Sufficient Sleep
Immunity is heavily influenced by the **quality and quantity of sleep**. 7-8 hours of sound sleep daily promotes the activity of immune cells and increases resistance to infection.

- Consistent bed and wake times
- Minimize smartphone use before bed
- Maintain a dark environment

## 2. Balanced Nutrition Intake
Vitamins and minerals are essential for maintaining the immune system.

| Nutrient | Function | Representative Foods |
|--------|------|-----------|
| Vitamin C | Antioxidant, Boosts Immunity | Oranges, Kiwi |
| Vitamin D | Immune Regulation | Salmon, Eggs |
| Zinc | Immune Cell Activation | Nuts |

## 3. Stress Management
Chronic stress suppresses immune function.

> Need to maintain psychological stability through meditation, light walks, or hobbies.

## 4. Establishing a Daily Routine
- Regular meals
- Consistent exercise habits
- Sufficient hydration

Integrating these factors helps not only in preventing colds but also in maintaining long-term health.

title: Exercise Routine for Cold Prevention
content:
# 🏃 Cold Prevention Exercise Routine

![Treadmill](러닝머신.png)

## Core Concept
Exercise is an important factor in strengthening immunity, and **cardio** is particularly effective.

## Recommended Routine
### 1. Warm-up (5 min)
- Light stretching
- Walking in place

### 2. Cardio (15~20 min)
- Brisk walking
- Light jogging

### 3. Strength Training (10 min)
- Squats: 15 reps × 3 sets
- Push-ups: 10 reps × 3 sets

### 4. Cool-down
- Stretching and breath regulation

## Precautions
- Excessive exercise can lower immunity
- Sufficient rest after exercise is essential

## Nutrition
Post-exercise intake recommendations:
- Protein (Muscle recovery)
- Vitamin C (Antioxidant)

> Maintaining a consistent routine is key to cold prevention.

title: Spring Healthy Diet, More Balanced!
content:
# 🌱 Spring Healthy Diet, More Balanced!

![Spring](spring.jpg)
## Overview
Spring, as the seasons change, is a good time to look back at your lifestyle rhythm and eating habits and start healthy changes. Recently, 'high-protein diets' and 'low-sugar/zero products' are popular, but focusing only on specific nutrients can break the balance of your eating habits. We introduce how to manage healthy and balanced meals, focusing on protein intake and choosing low-sugar/zero products.

## Diet Improvement Direction

### 🔻 What to Eat Less of
- Simple sugars (sweetened drinks, cookies, desserts)
- Sodium (processed foods, soup/stew broth)

### 🟢 What to Fill Up On
- Protein (meat, tofu, eggs, etc.)
- Dietary fiber (vegetables, whole grains)
- Healthy fats (fish, nuts, unsaturated fatty acids)

## Protein Intake Guide

### ⚖️ The Right Amount of Protein for My Body
- Recommended amount: About 0.8-1.2g per 1kg of body weight daily.
- How to consume: Divide into three meals a day, consuming about 20g per meal.
- 20g examples: 100g chicken breast, 100g lean meat, 100g fish, 3 eggs, one block of tofu.

### ⚠️ Precautions
- Excessive intake of protein supplements can burden the kidneys.
- Seniors must consistently consume softly cooked protein.

## How to Use Low-Sugar/Zero Products

### 💡 Meaning of Low-Sugar/Zero
- Low-sugar: 5g or less of sugars per 100g of food.
- Zero (Sugar-free): Less than 0.5g of sugars per 100g of food.
- 0 kcal: Less than 4kcal per 100g/mL (may contain a small amount of calories).

### 🥤 Usage Tips
- Use only as a supplementary means to reduce sugar.
- Usually drink water or unsweetened tea.
- Check other ingredients like sweeteners and caffeine and consume appropriate amounts.

---

## Implementation Method
- Consume carbohydrates, proteins, fats, and dietary fiber evenly.
- Practice the 'Reverse Eating Method' (Vegetables → Protein → Rice order).
- Habit of checking nutrition facts labels and recording in smartphone apps.
- Combine 150 minutes or more of moderate-intensity cardio per week with strength training twice a week.

> Whatever the diet, balance that fits you is more important than trends.

Healthy eating habits start with small choices in daily life.

title: Mediterranean Diet Guide to Lower Blood Pressure
content:
# 🍅 Mediterranean Diet for Preventing High Blood Pressure

![Mediterranean Diet](지중해식.jpg)

## Overview
Changing eating habits is most important for managing high blood pressure. Reducing simple sugars and saturated fatty acids and maintaining a Mediterranean-style diet (DASH diet) focused on vegetables and seafood is effective in lowering blood pressure.

## Good Diet for High Blood Pressure

### 🥗 Plenty of Vegetables and Fruits
- Consume fresh vegetables and fruits every day.
- Potassium in fruits and vegetables helps excrete sodium.

### 🐟 Healthy Proteins and Fats
- Consume fish at least twice a week.
- Increase intake of tofu, beans, and nuts.
- Composition focused on plant-based proteins rather than meat.

### 🌾 Whole Grains and Dietary Fiber
- Consume multi-grain rice like brown rice, barley, and oats instead of white rice.
- Fill up on dietary fiber by consuming seaweed.

## Foods to Watch Out For
- Salted foods (salted seafood, pickles, kimchi varieties)
- Processed foods (ham, canned food, ramen)
- Soup dishes (focus on the ingredients rather than the broth when eating soup or stew)

> The habit of eating bland food creates healthy blood vessels.

Try to keep your blood pressure levels stable with consistent daily diet management.

title: Top 5 Ingredients for Blood Sugar Management for Diabetics
content:
# 🍽️ Recommended Foods for Diabetes Management

![Diabetes Management Food](당뇨.png)

## Overview
If you are in the pre-diabetic stage or have diabetes, blood sugar management through food is essential. We introduce high-nutrition foods that do not raise blood sugar sharply.

## Recommended Ingredients

### 1. Brown Rice and Whole Grains
Consuming brown rice rich in dietary fiber instead of white rice allows for slow digestion, leading to a gentle rise in blood sugar. Oats and barley are also good choices.

### 2. Legumes
Kidney beans, mung beans, red beans, black beans, etc., are rich in dietary fiber and high in protein, helping insulin action and lowering cholesterol levels.

### 3. Nuts
Walnuts, almonds, etc., are rich in minerals and unsaturated fatty acids needed by diabetics, preventing blood sugar from rising.

### 4. Berries
When you crave something sweet, berries like blueberries and raspberries, which are rich in antioxidants and dietary fiber, are better than cookies.

### 5. Seaweed
Seaweed like kelp and wakame is rich in soluble dietary fiber, preventing a sharp rise in blood sugar after meals.

> Smartly choosing what to eat is the key to diabetes management, rather than just starving yourself.

Make it a habit to consume appropriate amounts regularly.

title: Safe Exercise Methods to Reduce Joint Pain
content:
# 🦵 Exercise Guide to Protect Knees and Joints

![Yoga](요가.jpg)

## Overview
If you don't move because of arthritis or knee pain, your joints will stiffen further and muscles will decrease. We introduce safe exercise methods that strengthen surrounding muscles without putting a burden on joints.

## Recommended Exercise Methods

### 🧘‍♀️ Stretching and Flexibility Exercises
Do light stretching every morning and evening to relax the muscles around the joints. This restores the range of motion of stiffened joints and prevents rigidity.

### 🚶‍♂️ Low-Intensity Cardio
- Walking on flat ground
- Indoor cycling
- Water exercises (swimming, aqua aerobics)
It is good to do this consistently 3-5 times a week for 30 minutes a day.

### 🧘‍♂️ Yoga and Pilates
Effective in increasing flexibility and balance, relieving stress, and easing joint pain.

### 🏋️‍♂️ Strength Strengthening
Reduce the load on joints by strengthening muscles around them with exercises like Wall Squats, where you lean your back against a wall.

## Precautions
- Always do sufficient stretching before exercise.
- Avoid excessive strength training or jumping movements.

> Regular low-intensity exercise creates pain-free joints.

title: Protecting My Eyes from Smartphones, Good Foods for Eyes

title: Overcome Chronic Insomnia! Sleep Hygiene Guide for Good Sleep
content:
# 🌙 Lifestyle Habits for Healthy Sleep

 ![Insomnia](sleep2.jpg)

 ## Overview
Insomnia, the most common sleep disorder, should prioritize non-pharmacological treatments (sleep hygiene, cognitive behavioral therapy) that improve sleep habits and environments rather than unconditionally relying on drugs.

## Rules for Good Sleep

### ⏰ Regular Life
- Maintain a consistent wake-up time.
- Do vigorous exercise in the morning.

### 🛏️ Correct Bedroom Environment
- Use the bed only for sleeping (No reading, smartphone use, or eating).
- Create a dark, quiet, and cool environment.

### 🚫 Things to Avoid Before Bed
- Avoid caffeine intake 6 hours before sleeping.
- Avoid late-night drinking and overeating.
- No use of electronic devices (smartphones, etc.) right before bed.

### 🧘‍♀️ Sleep Induction Tips
- Take a warm shower before bed.
- Meditation or light relaxation exercises.
- If you can't sleep for more than 30 minutes, get up and do a quiet activity (reading, etc.) and lie back down when sleepy.

> Make your body remember that the bed is only for sleeping.

Overcome chronic fatigue and sleep disorders with consistent sleep hygiene practice.

title: Respiratory Health Rules to Overcome Fine Dust
content:
# 😷 Protecting My Body from Spring Fine Dust

 ![Fine Dust](micro.jpg)
## Overview
Fine dust that comes regardless of the season is the main culprit of respiratory diseases and allergies. We look into how to minimize fine dust damage and increase respiratory immunity in daily life.

## Daily Prevention Rules

### 💧 Sufficient Hydration
Keeping the bronchial mucosa moist by drinking 1.5-2L of water daily prevents fine dust from entering deep into the body and helps excretion.

### 🧼 Thorough Personal Hygiene
Always wash your hands, feet, and face after going out, and remove fine dust in the oral cavity through tooth brushing and gargling.

### 😷 Correct Mask Wearing
When the fine dust concentration is 'Bad' or higher, refrain from going out, and if unavoidable, wear a health mask (KF80 or higher) certified by the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety closely.

### 🏠 Indoor Air Quality Management
- Ventilate briefly during times when the fine dust concentration is low.
- Periodically replace filters when using an air purifier.
- Always ventilate after grilling or frying food.

> Fine dust is an invisible threat. Check the forecast every day and prepare thoroughly.

title: Forgetting Often? Diet to Awaken Your Memory and Brain

title: Healthy Weight Management Exercise Without Yo-Yo Effect
content:
# ⚖️ Smart Exercise Routine to Lose Weight Without Starving

![Strength Training](근력운동.jpg)

## Overview
A real diet is about reducing body fat and maintaining muscle rather than just reducing the number on the scale. We suggest exercise methods for healthy weight management without the yo-yo effect.

## Effective Weight Management Exercises

### 🔥 Combining Cardio and Strength Training
Cardio is essential for burning body fat, but to increase basal metabolic rate and create a body type that doesn't gain weight, you must combine it with strength training. We recommend 3 days of cardio and 2 days of strength training a week.

### ⏱️ Using Fasted Cardio
If you walk lightly or ride an indoor bike for about 30 minutes on an empty stomach in the morning, fat burning efficiency is high because there are fewer carbohydrates in the body. (However, diabetics should avoid it due to the risk of hypoglycemia.)

### 💪 Strength Training Focusing on Large Muscles
Exercises that use the largest muscles in our body (thighs, buttocks, chest) like squats, lunges, and push-ups have the highest calorie consumption.

## Precautions
- Hydration and proper protein intake after exercise are essential.
- Set achievable weekly plans rather than excessive exercise goals.

> Diet is a process of creating habits that can be maintained for a lifetime.

title: Managing High Blood Pressure with a Vegetarian-Focused Diet
content:
# Vegetable-Centered Diet to Lower High Blood Pressure

![Vegetable-Centered Diet](채식.jpg)

## Overview
A diet rich in fruits, vegetables, and fiber is more effective in lowering blood pressure than a meat-centered diet. We introduce how to reduce animal protein and saturated fatty acids and fill up with healthy nutrients.

## Benefits of a Vegetable-Centered Diet
Potassium, fiber, and minerals in vegetables and fruits help excrete sodium from the body and soften blood vessels, giving a complex effect of lowering blood pressure.

## Food Groups Good for High Blood Pressure

### Vegetables and Fruits to Eat Every Day
- Dark green vegetables (spinach, broccoli, etc.)
- Fresh seasonal fruits (those not too high in sugar)

### Alternative Proteins
- Consume skinless chicken or fish instead of high-fat animal meat.
- Actively use plant-based proteins like tofu and legumes.

### Whole Grains
- Consume multi-grain rice instead of refined white rice (2/3 to 1 bowl per meal).

## Precautions
- Avoid high-fat meats like pork belly and ribs if possible.
- Reduce intake of simple sugars like sugar and total fat.

> Healthy blood pressure management starts at the daily table. Gradually increase your vegetable intake.

title: "I just turned off the light for a moment"... Actions done unintentionally before bed, the number one exposure to serious diseases has emerged.
content:
# You Don't Get Sick If You Sleep Well

![Sleep Deprivation](sleep.jfif)## Overview
Sleep is not just time to let the body rest. Sufficient sleep is the most basic condition for body recovery and maintaining immunity, our body's defense system.

## Relationship Between Sleep and Immunity
If sleep is insufficient, hormone imbalance occurs, and the function of immune cells drops. Accumulated fatigue can lead to complications beyond simple lethargy.

## Sleep Habits to Boost Immunity

### Securing the Golden Time
Get 7-8 hours of sufficient sleep, and make sure to fall into a deep sleep between 11 PM and 3-4 AM when immune activity is most active.

### Sunlight Shower During the Day
To improve the quality of sleep, it is good to get at least 30 minutes of bright sunlight during the day to help the secretion of melatonin, the sleep hormone.

### Relaxation Before Bed
Taking a half-bath or foot-bath with warm water before bed is very helpful for relaxing a stiff body and inducing deep sleep.

> Even short-term sleep disorders become chronic if neglected. Sleep well tonight.

title: Move More When Tired! Paradoxical Exercise Method to Beat Chronic Fatigue
content:
# Exercise Done When Tired Is a Medicine

![Stretching](스트레칭.jpg)

## Overview
Unconditionally lying down and resting is not the only answer when suffering from chronic fatigue. Rather, appropriate physical activity can be the ultimate solution to pull up physical strength and reduce fatigue.

## Principle of How Exercise Reduces Fatigue
Light exercise promotes blood circulation and increases the activity of 'mitochondria,' the factory that makes energy in cells, restoring body energy.

## Exercise Guide for Fatigue Recovery

### Low-Intensity Cardio
Start with basic walking, cycling, swimming, and other cardio 5 days a week, 5-15 minutes at a time, and gradually increase according to your body condition. (Max 30 minutes)

### Stretching in Daily Life
You can relax stiff muscles and lower fatigue just by stretching, like stretching your arms or lightly twisting your waist in your seat.

## Precautions
Avoid excessive exercise that goes beyond the limit in a fatigued state. Maintain an intensity (about 60% of maximum oxygen consumption) where you sweat slightly but are not out of breath.

> Try a light walk around the neighborhood when your body feels heavy.

title: Silent Bone Thief, Calcium Diet to Prevent Osteoporosis
content:
# Eating Habits to Fill Up Strongly to the Bone

![Bone Health Vitamin D](비타민D.jpg)

## Overview
Osteoporosis, where bones break easily even with small impacts, is more dangerous because there are no early symptoms. We introduce a nutritional diet that inhibits bone destruction and increases bone density.

## Essential Nutrients for Bone Health

### Increase Calcium Intake
Calcium is key to bone health. Frequently include dairy products like milk, low-fat yogurt, and cheese, and tofu, legumes, and fish eaten with bones (anchovies, sardines) in your diet.

### Take Vitamin D
Vitamin D, which helps calcium absorption, is created by sunlight exposure, but it is also good to supplement through foods like salmon, egg yolks, and mushrooms.

### Green Leafy Vegetables
Dark green vegetables like bok choy, broccoli, and collards, which are rich in calcium and Vitamin K, contribute to making bones strong.

## Eating Habits to Avoid
The habit of eating salty food and excessive caffeine (coffee, etc.) intake, which promotes calcium excretion in the body, are enemies of osteoporosis and must be reduced.

> Calcium accumulated consistently from a young age creates a healthy gait in old age.

title: Pain Relieving Water Exercises for Arthritis Patients
content:
# Lightly Protecting Joint Health in the Water

![Swimming](수영.jpg)

## Overview
If even walking is a burden because of severe knee or joint pain, water exercises using the buoyancy of water are the best alternative. We introduce how to build muscle without putting a burden on joints.

## Advantages of Water Exercises
In the water, body weight is distributed, greatly reducing the pressure on joints. Also, thanks to the resistance of water, energy consumption is large even with small movements, making it effective for both weight management and muscle strengthening.

## Recommended Water Exercise Programs

### Aqua Walking (Walking in Water)
Walking in water at waist or chest height puts less burden on lower body joints and effectively strengthens thigh muscles than walking on land.

### Aqua Aerobics
Performing aerobic movements in the water to cheerful music is excellent for improving cardiorespiratory endurance and relieving stress.

### Swimming (Freestyle/Backstroke)
Develops whole body muscles evenly while almost no body weight is loaded on joints. (However, breaststroke requires caution as it can put a burden on knee joints.)

> Don't give up exercise because of pain. Water exercises can be a safe solution.

title: Correct Eating Order to Prevent Blood Sugar Spikes
content:
# Catching Blood Sugar with Reverse Eating Method 

![Blood Sugar](blood.jpg)## Overview
The key to diabetes management is to prevent 'blood sugar spikes,' where blood sugar soars sharply after a meal. If it is hard to reduce the amount you eat, you can see great effects just by changing the order of eating.

## Importance of Eating Order
If carbohydrates enter the body first, they are rapidly broken down into glucose, sharply raising blood sugar. Consuming dietary fiber and protein first can slow down the digestion and absorption speed of carbohydrates.

## Correct Reverse Eating Method

### Step 1: Vegetables (Dietary Fiber)
When starting a meal, eat vegetables like salads or seasoned vegetables first. This creates a dietary fiber defense wall in the gut to interfere with sugar absorption.

### Step 2: Meat and Fish (Protein)
After vegetables, consume protein side dishes like lean meat, fish, tofu, or eggs to fill up with solid satiety.

### Step 3: Rice (Carbohydrates)
Eat rice (brown or multi-grain rice if possible) last. Thanks to the food eaten previously, you also get the effect of eating less rice than usual.

> 'How you eat' is as important as what you eat. Try changing the order starting with today's meal.

title: Digital Detox Practices for Brain Aging Prevention
content:
# Turn Off Smartphone and Wake Up Brain Cells

![Detox](digital.png)## Overview
Modern people who rely on smartphones for everything are increasingly losing their ability to remember and think for themselves, experiencing 'digital dementia.' We look into how to rest a tired brain and restore memory.

## Dangers of Brain Overload
Short-form videos (shorts, etc.) and a flood of information that pours out without rest keep the brain in a state of tension, lowering deep thinking ability and concentration.

## Daily Practice Tips for Brain Rest

### Have a 'Space Out' Time
Try to just space out while looking out the window without looking at a smartphone or TV for even 10 minutes a day. The 'Default Mode Network,' where the brain organizes information and tidies up memories, is activated.

### Reading and Hand-Writing
Instead of passively watching videos, exercise your imagination by reading books and stimulate the brain's cognitive function by writing diaries or notes by hand.

### No Smartphone Before Bed
Blue light from a smartphone right before sleep interferes with sleep and increases brain stress. A habit of keeping devices away in bed is needed.

> True brain rest starts with turning off the switch of information for a moment.

title: A Mild Diet to Reduce Sodium
content:
# Diet to Reduce Saltiness and Up Health

![High Blood Pressure Low-Sodium Diet](고혈압.jpg)

## Overview
Reducing sodium intake is most important for managing high blood pressure. We introduce low-sodium eating methods recommended by the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency and the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, and foods that help lower blood pressure.

## Foods that Lower Blood Pressure

### Onions and Garlic
Quercetin in onions and Allicin in garlic are effective in lowering cholesterol levels and reducing both systolic and diastolic blood pressure.

### Dark Green Vegetables
Green vegetables like spinach are rich in potassium, folic acid, and magnesium, helping excrete sodium and maintaining blood pressure levels stably.

### Nuts and Fish
Nuts like almonds and walnuts, and fish like salmon and mackerel, are rich in unsaturated fatty acids, aiding vascular health.

## Implementation Guide
- Reduce intake of salted foods like pickles, salted seafood, and kimchi.
- Eat soup or stew focusing on the ingredients rather than the broth.
- Supplement magnesium with a piece of dark chocolate after a meal.

> Getting used to a bland taste is the first step in treating high blood pressure.

title: Grains and Vegetables to Prevent Post-Meal Blood Sugar Spikes
content:
# Smart Carbohydrate Intake Method

![Blood Sugar Management Avocado](아보카도.jpg)

## Overview
Diabetes diet therapy is not about unconditionally not eating, but about evenly consuming healthy foods that raise blood sugar slowly. We look into ingredients that help blood sugar management.

## Recommended Foods for Blood Sugar Regulation

### Whole Grains (Brown Rice, Oats, Barley)
Consuming whole grains rich in dietary fiber instead of white rice allows digestion to proceed slowly, preventing post-meal blood sugar from rising sharply. Beta-glucan delays glucose absorption.

### Vegetables Rich in Dietary Fiber
Cabbage, spinach, broccoli, etc., are full of dietary fiber, the carbohydrate that is excreted from the body, and inhibit blood sugar rise when eaten with rice or noodles.

### Avocado and Legumes
Avocados with healthy unsaturated fatty acids and legumes rich in protein help insulin action and provide satiety, making them effective for weight management.

## Precautions
Intake of fruits high in sugar, refined flour, and processed foods high in sugar must be restricted as they cause blood sugar spikes.

> Change the white carbohydrates on your table to coarse whole grains.

title: Thigh Strength Strengthening Exercises to Protect Joint Cartilage
content:
# Making a Reliable Support to Protect Knees

![Indoor Cycling](실내자전거.jpg)

## Overview
If you don't move when there is pain due to arthritis or aging, muscles decrease, putting a greater burden on joints. We introduce exercise methods that build thigh muscles that wrap around and protect joints.

## Exercise Methods to Protect Knee Joints

### Indoor Cycling
It is the best cardio and strength exercise that can effectively strengthen the front thigh muscles (quadriceps) without putting direct weight load on joints.

### Extending Legs While Sitting on a Chair
Sit correctly on a chair, slowly lift one leg horizontally, hold for 10 seconds, and lower it. Do it alternately on both sides, feeling the strength in your thighs.

### Wall Squat (Sitting While Leaning on a Wall)
Lean your back against a wall and slightly bend your knees to maintain a posture as if sitting on a transparent chair. It is safer than a regular squat as the pressure on knee joints is less.

## Precautions
If the pain becomes too severe to bear, you must stop exercising immediately and rest, and it is helpful to use warm or cold compresses to relieve pain.

> Strong thigh muscles absorb the impact on joints instead.

title: Key to Immunity, Probiotic Diet to Revive Gut Microbes
content:
# My Body Is Strong Only If the Gut Is Strong

![Gut Health Probiotics](유산균.jpg)

## Overview
70% of our body's immune cells are distributed in the gut. We introduce eating habits that maximize immunity by increasing beneficial gut bacteria and inhibiting harmful bacteria.

## Eating Habits for Gut Microbiome Balance

### Prebiotics (Food for Beneficial Bacteria)
Dietary fiber, rich in onions, garlic, bananas, oats, chicory, etc., goes down to the large intestine without being digested and becomes excellent food for probiotics (Bifidobacteria, etc.).

### Probiotics (Beneficial Bacteria Itself)
Consistently consume traditional fermented foods like kimchi, doenjang, and cheonggukjang, or yogurt. Beneficial bacteria created during the fermentation process make the gut environment acidic, preventing the growth of harmful bacteria.

### Sufficient Hydration
Drinking 1.5-2L of water daily is essential for dietary fiber to move and act smoothly in the gut.

## Precautions
Processed foods and refined sugar (simple sugars) can become food for harmful bacteria and cause gut inflammation, so it is better to reduce intake as much as possible.

> The daily diet determines the ecosystem of microbes in my gut.

title: How to Consume Lutein and Zeaxanthin to Delay Smartphone Presbyopia
content:
# Filling Up Macular Pigment, the Eye's Defense Wall

![Eye Health Lutein](눈2.jpg)

## Overview
Eyes of modern people are tired from long hours of smartphone and monitor use. We look into foods rich in lutein and zeaxanthin, the core nutrients that protect the center of the retina and delay presbyopia and vision decline.

## Recommended Ingredients for Eye Health

### Spinach and Kale
Dark green and yellow vegetables contain high concentrations of lutein, which protects the retina of the eye and absorbs blue light.

### Corn and Bell Peppers
Rich in zeaxanthin, the partner of lutein, which is responsible for central vision and color recognition. Since it is a fat-soluble nutrient, the absorption rate increases when lightly sautéed in oil.

### Egg Yolks
The content is less than in vegetables, but the absorption rate in the body is very high, making it an excellent source to supplement lutein and zeaxanthin.

### Red Seafood like Salmon
Along with nutrients that protect the retina, it is rich in astaxanthin, which gives energy to the muscles that adjust the eye's focus to relieve fatigue.

> Once damaged vision is hard to restore. Take care of your diet for your eyes starting today.

title: Walking Exercise that Aids Blood Circulation and Strengthens the Heart
content:
# Clear Blood Vessels Opened by Walking

![Walking Exercise](걷기운동.jpg)

## Overview
The safest natural blood circulation improver without side effects is walking. We introduce correct walking exercise methods that raise heart rate and give elasticity to blood vessels.

## Amazing Effects of Walking Exercise
Regular walking promotes the pumping action of the calf muscles (the second heart) so that blood pumped out of the heart circulates through the whole body and returns smoothly to the heart.

## Effective Walking Guide

### Time and Intensity
Do it for more than 30 minutes a day, 5 times a week. 'Brisk walking (Power walking),' where you are slightly out of breath when talking to the person next to you, is much more effective in dilating blood vessels and breaking down lipids than walking slowly as if taking a stroll.

### Correct Posture
Gaze 10-15m ahead and straighten your back. Your feet should touch from the heel first, rolling through the whole sole, and push off with the big toe.

## Precautions
Prevent joint damage and injury by stretching ankles, knees, and thighs for more than 5 minutes before and after exercise.

> The habit of consistent daily walking is the best vaccine to prevent cardiovascular diseases.

title: "Never apply sunscreen" If you apply sunscreen without 'this'...
content:
# 20 Minutes a Day, Natural Vitamin Obtained for Free

![Mental](metal.jpg)
## Overview
Modern people who live indoors for long hours always suffer from a lack of sunlight. Appropriate sunbathing is excellent for refreshing the mood and recovering from fatigue, in addition to simple vitamin production.

## Effect of Sunlight on Our Body

### Secretion of Happiness Hormone Serotonin
When receiving sunlight, the secretion of 'serotonin' in the brain is promoted, reducing depression, relieving stress, and bringing peace of mind.

### Inducing Good Sleep
Serotonin secreted during the day is converted into 'melatonin,' the sleep hormone, at night, resolving insomnia and helping you sleep deeply to recover from chronic fatigue.

### Vitamin D Synthesis
When the skin receives UV rays from sunlight, it synthesizes Vitamin D in the body, increasing immunity and protecting bone health.

## Correct Sunbathing Method
It is better to avoid midday (11 AM to 2 PM) when UV rays are too strong, and get 20-30 minutes of sunlight on your face or limbs in the morning or late afternoon without applying sunscreen.

> Leave the stuffy indoors and walk outside for a while to recharge your vitality.

title: Breakfast that Aids Brain Rotation and Increases Memory
content:
# Breakfast Wakes Up the Brain

![Brain Health Egg Breakfast](달걀.png)

## Overview
Breakfast is the most important meal that supplies energy to the brain that was starving during sleep. We introduce a brain-customized breakfast diet to maximize concentration and memory.

## Recommended Ingredients to Wake Up the Brain

### Eggs
Rich in protein and 'choline,' the raw material for brain neurotransmitters, helping to increase memory and prevent brain aging. It is better to eat them soft-boiled or boiled rather than fried or scrambled for better digestion.

### Bananas
Rich in carbohydrates, they supply immediate glucose energy to the brain, and being rich in Vitamin B, they are good for relieving stress and fatigue.

### Walnuts and Almonds
Rich in unsaturated fatty acids and Vitamin E, they protect brain nerve cells and improve brain blood flow, increasing morning concentration. It becomes a great breakfast when eaten with milk, like in oatmeal.

## Breakfast to Avoid
Meals high in sugar, like cereals or sweet breads, can sharply raise blood sugar and instead cause strong fatigue and sleepiness during the morning.

> The start of a vibrant day comes from a solid and nutritional breakfast table.

title: Weight-Bearing Exercises to Fill Up Bones Strongly
content:
# Bones Becoming Solid While Overcoming Gravity

![Aerobics](에어로빅.jpg)

## Overview
To prevent osteoporosis, where bone density decreases, exercise that gives physical stimulus to bones is as essential as calcium intake. We look into weight-bearing exercises that make bones strong.

<iframe width="100%" height="400" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/rQONrQFyi9w?list=RDrQONrQFyi9w" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Principle of Weight-Bearing Exercise
Bones have a property of trying to increase bone density and become solid by themselves to withstand the pressure and weight (body weight) applied to them. Therefore, you must consistently do exercises where body weight is loaded on the bones.

## Recommended Exercises for Osteoporosis Prevention

### Walking and Jogging
The most basic and safe weight-bearing exercises. The impact of stepping on the ground stimulates the osteoblasts of the bone, making the bone strong.

### Dancing and Aerobics
Cheerful movements of stomping feet and catching the rhythm give appropriate stimulus to the spine and lower body bones, and are also effective in preventing falls by increasing balance.

### Stair Climbing
It gives a larger stimulus to bones than walking on flat ground and can also strengthen lower body muscles. (However, use the elevator when coming down to protect knee joints.)

> Swimming or cycling are good for cardiorespiratory function, but since body weight is not loaded on bones, the osteoporosis prevention effect is small.

title: Even VVIP Ladies with Tens of Billions of Won Apply It Within 3 Minutes
content:
# Bringing Rain to Dry Skin and Respiratory System

![Dry Skin](skin.jfif)

## Overview
Dry indoor air breaks the skin barrier, causing itching, and dries the bronchial mucosa, increasing the risk of viral infection. We look into how to maintain a pleasant indoor environment.

## How to Maintain Proper Indoor Humidity

### Securing 40-60% Humidity
The most ideal indoor humidity for health is 40-60%. Provide a hygrometer to check, and if the humidity drops, use a humidifier or hang wet towels or laundry to adjust the humidity.

### Using Natural Humidifying Plants
Foliage plants like Areca palms and Scindapsus have active transpiration, increasing indoor humidity and even providing air purification effects like removing fine dust.

### Refrain from Frequent Bathing and Scrubbing
When the skin is dry, avoid frequent showers or hot water baths, and refrain from scrubbing as it thins the skin's moisture protective layer.

## Lifestyle Rules
Immediately after bathing (within 3 minutes) before the moisture dries, apply moisturizer sufficiently all over the body to prevent moisture inside the skin from evaporating.

> Moist indoor air completes moist and healthy skin.
